achievements.description: Kill the enemy in the porta-potty.
achievements.summary: Kill the enemy inside the porta-potty in @loc{Dark Water}.

guide.context: If a teammate kills him first, reload the last checkpoint and try again.

steps.text: After climbing the first stairs, shoot the left porta-potty before your teammates do.

achievements.description: Kill gassed or blinded enemies using a Molotov, Semtex and Frag in 'Prison Break'.
achievements.summary: Use a Molotov, a Semtex and a Frag to kill enemies who are gassed or blinded, during @loc{Prison Break}.

steps.text: Throw tear gas or a flashbang at a group, then kill enemies affected by it with one Molotov, one Semtex and one Frag.
Tear gas lasts longer than a flashbang, so use it first.

achievements.description: Shoot three enemies while underwater in 'Wetwork'.
achievements.summary: Shoot three enemies while you are underwater in @loc{Wetwork}.

guide.context: The three kills do not need to happen in a row.

steps.text: Go forward and slightly left from the start, kill the man on the pier and take his P890.
Stay underwater near the surface and shoot three enemies from there. Press C to dip under.

achievements.description: While affected by one Flashbang, kill two enemies in the Campaign or in Co-op.
achievements.summary: Kill two enemies during the effect of a single flashbang, either in Campaign missions or in Spec Ops.

guide.context: Any campaign mission works. Flashing yourself counts.

steps.text: Throw a flash grenade at your own feet.
While you are still flashed, shoot two enemies.
In @loc{Cartel Protection}, two cartel members stand lined up on the path just past the first door.

achievements.description: Open three safes in the Campaign.
achievements.summary: Open three safes in the Campaign.

guide.context: One safe is in @loc{El Sin Nombre} and two are in @loc{Alone}. Progress carries between missions.

steps.text: In @loc{El Sin Nombre}, open the closet in Diego's room and enter 02-02-19 on the safe.
In @loc{Alone}, pry open the locked door on the floor where the bleeding man crawls out, then enter 10-10-80 on the safe.
In @loc{Alone}, after dropping from the broken railing, go left into the mechanic shop, then enter 37-60-80 on the safe in the back room.

achievements.description: Reach the penthouse in 'El Sin Nombre' without killing anyone or triggering the alarm.
achievements.summary: Reach the penthouse in @loc{El Sin Nombre} without killing anyone and without raising the alarm.

guide.context: Reloading a checkpoint when you are spotted still counts.

steps.text: Throw bottles to pull guards away from your path.
Hide in the closet beside Diego, grab the keycard, then leave through the window onto the roof.
Climb the ladder to Alejandro, ride down the elevator shaft and hit the emergency brake above the elevator door.
Exit on the third floor and walk to the penthouse.

achievements.description: Rescue the hostages in 'Countdown' without the enemies firing their weapons.
achievements.summary: Rescue the hostages in @loc{Countdown} without any enemy firing a weapon.

guide.context: Each hostage room has a set number of enemies, and Ghost calls it out.

steps.text: Use the VEL-46 for its large magazine.
In each room, kill every enemy before any can fire: 2 in the first, 4 in the second (3 inside, 1 in the hallway), and 5 in the third.
Clear from left to right. Wait for the two middle enemies to line up, then drop them together.

achievements.description: Reach the barge without being seen in 'Wetwork'.
achievements.summary: Reach the barge in @loc{Wetwork} without being seen.

guide.context: Reloading a checkpoint after being spotted still counts.

steps.text: Sweep the docks and kill the guards one at a time.
Wait for the patrol boat to turn, then shoot the two crew from behind.
Climb up the dock to Price and enter the barge.

achievements.description: Never trigger the alarm in 'Recon by Fire'.
achievements.summary: Never trigger the alarm in @loc{Recon by Fire}.

guide.context: Only the sniping sections count. Being spotted while clearing the buildings does not matter. If an alarm starts, reload the checkpoint before it.

steps.text: In each sniping section, wait for Price's spotter call before you shoot.
Do not miss shots, and aim for the head on armored guards.

achievements.description: Finish 'Alone' without firing a gun.
achievements.summary: Finish @loc{Alone} without firing a gun.

guide.context: Melee, knives and thrown items are fine. The crossbow counts as a gun. If you fire any gun, replay the mission.

steps.text: Stay hidden and use takedowns, your knife and throwing knives to kill.
Follow Ghost back to the truck and climb into the passenger seat to end the mission.

achievements.description: Complete the CCTV sequence in four minutes.
achievements.summary: Complete the CCTV sequence in @loc{Prison Break} within four minutes.

guide.context: The timer stops while the game is paused.

steps.text: After reaching the CCTV room with Ghost, finish every camera task in under four minutes.

achievements.description: Reach Price using the first vehicle you hijack.
achievements.summary: Reach Price in @loc{Violence and Timing} in the first vehicle you hijack.

guide.context: The truck you land on at the start has high health. Restart the checkpoint to begin on it again.

steps.text: Hijack one vehicle and keep it for the whole mission.
Drive until Price pulls up in a large cargo truck, climb out onto it and jump in.

achievements.description: Shoot all the targets in the training area in 'Ghost Team'.
achievements.summary: Shoot every target in the training area of @loc{Ghost Team}.

guide.context: Play on Recruit if you can, since enemies also shoot at you.

steps.text: After Rudy helps you over the wall, kill the enemies first. Do not pick up rockets or C4.
Shoot every target; the achievement unlocks after the last one.
Grab the M4 with the thermal scope from near the missile door to spot targets.

achievements.description: Finish the Campaign on any difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish the @loc{Modern Warfare II} Campaign on any difficulty.

steps.text: Play through all 17 missions to the end of @loc{Countdown}.

achievements.description: Drive five vehicle types in 'Violence and Timing'.
achievements.summary: Drive five different vehicle types in @loc{Violence and Timing}.

guide.context: Counted types: car, van, armored car, pickup, and flatbed truck (covered or open).

steps.text: Hijack the truck you land on, then the truck next to it.
Hijack a parked car on the right, a van at the turn, then a large utility truck in the convoy.

achievements.description: In 'Dark Water' advance 90 meters towards the front of the ship without touching the deck.
achievements.summary: Cover 90 meters toward the bow of the ship in @loc{Dark Water} while never touching the deck.

guide.context: If you touch the deck, reload the last checkpoint and try again.

steps.text: Climb onto the container from the boat, cross the railing to the platform, then jump across the blue container, the missile crate and the large crate.
Hop the blue and red containers to the next platform and clear the enemies.
Continue along the railing to the life raft under the stairwell.

achievements.description: Finish all Campaign missions on Veteran or Realism difficulty.
achievements.summary: Finish every Campaign mission on Veteran or Realism difficulty.

guide.context: Realism opens only after you finish the Campaign once. The achievement can take a minute to appear after the credits start.

steps.text: Play all missions on Veteran. Replay any mission you finished on a lower difficulty.

achievements.description: Kill three Enemies with the Riot Shield in the Campaign or in Co-op.
achievements.summary: Get three kills using a Riot Shield, either in Campaign missions or in Spec Ops.

steps.text: In @loc{Prison Break}, take a shield from a riot shielder, flash the enemies in the cafe, then melee three of them.

achievements.description: Complete 'Low Profile' without triggering any Alarms.
achievements.summary: Collect all three radioactive materials in @loc{Low Profile} without triggering any alarm.

guide.context: Finishing the mission is not needed. A guard sounds the alarm when he sees you, not when he finds a body. If an alarm sounds, leave to the lobby and restart; reloading a checkpoint does not work.

steps.text: Split up: one player takes C and the other takes A, then meet at A and go to B.
Kill enemies at the same time so none can react.
Take the materials; the achievement unlocks after the third.

achievements.description: Earn at least one Star in Co-op.
achievements.summary: Earn at least one star in a Spec Ops mission.

steps.text: Finish any Spec Ops mission.

achievements.description: Earn three Stars in 'Low Profile'.
achievements.summary: Earn three stars in @loc{Low Profile}.

guide.context: Three stars needs a clear in under 15:00.

steps.text: Split up at the plane: one player goes to C, the other to A.
Meet at A, then reach the last objective and exfil.

achievements.description: Earn three Stars in 'Defender: Mt. Zaya'.
achievements.summary: Earn three stars in @loc{Defender: Mt. Zaya}.

guide.context: Three stars needs 3 or fewer bombs planted. The bomb planted in round 1 on the first site does not count against this.

steps.text: Between rounds, buy reinforcements, sentries and cruise missiles, and refill ammo and armor plates.
Split up to cover the sites and kill enemies before they plant.

achievements.description: Earn three Stars in 'Denied Area'.
achievements.summary: Earn three stars in @loc{Denied Area}.

guide.context: Three stars needs a clear in under 16:00. Dying and pressing Retry does not fail the mission.

steps.text: Destroy the four SAM sites, driving between them.
After planting charges at the third site, you can both die to respawn closer to the last one.
Shoot down the helicopter at the end, then exfil.

achievements.description: Use 5 different Armaments in Open Combat Missions
achievements.summary: Use any five distinct Armaments during Open Combat Missions.

steps.text: Pick up and use Mosquito Drone, Bomb Drone, UAV, Sentry Gun and Cruise Missile in Precious Cargo.

achievements.description: Drive a vehicle with a Sentry Gun on the back and have it kill 5 enemies
achievements.summary: Drive a vehicle that has a Sentry Gun on its back and let it kill five enemies.

steps.text: In @loc{Precious Cargo}, use the Ascender by the rope at the foot of the northern ship to climb aboard, then take the Sentry Gun Armament from the side room upstairs.
Put it on the back of a vehicle (vehicles show as car icons on the map).
Drive near enemies until the sentry has killed five.

achievements.summary: Tag 60 enemies or items with the Spotter Scope in Open Combat Missions.

guide.context: The count adds up across missions and playthroughs.

steps.text: Use the Spotter Scope to tag enemies and items.

achievements.displayName: Have You Tried Turning it Off and On?
achievements.description: Use a Shock Stick to disable an enemy Sentry Gun
achievements.summary: Shut down an enemy Sentry Gun with a Shock Stick.

steps.text: In @loc{Reactor}, pick up a Shock Stick.
Throw it at an enemy sentry turret.

achievements.displayName: That's One Way to Do It...
achievements.description: Destroy an airborne enemy helicopter with a Mortar Strike
achievements.summary: Destroy a flying enemy helicopter with a Mortar Strike.

guide.context: A flying helicopter appears in @loc{Reactor} after two of the three grounded helicopters are destroyed.

steps.text: Destroy all three grounded helicopters first so you get a checkpoint. Leave the one nearest the start for last.
Pick up the Mortar Strike from the yard in the north-west near the start.
Call the strike on the flying helicopter while it hovers. If it moves away, reload the checkpoint and try again.
A Mortar Strike picked up before the checkpoint is lost when you reload.

achievements.description: Throw and hit an enemy directly with a Flammable Cannister then blow them up with it
achievements.summary: Throw a fused Flammable Canister so it hits an enemy directly, then blow that enemy up with it.

steps.text: At the start of @loc{Reactor}, land at the first helicopter and take a red canister from the building on its right.
Fuse the canister and throw it so it hits an enemy's body.
Let it explode and kill that same enemy. If he escapes, get another canister or reload the checkpoint.

achievements.description: BASE jump and travel more than 150 m with your parachute
achievements.summary: Glide over 150 m under your parachute after a BASE jump.

steps.text: At the start of @loc{Gora Dam}, jump off the base and open the parachute straight away.
Glide forward as far as you can, turning back if you reach the edge of the area.

achievements.description: Kill 10 enemies while using a zipline
achievements.summary: Kill 10 enemies while riding a zipline.

guide.context: Kills add up across rides and keep counting after a death or restart.

steps.text: In @loc{Reactor}, land on the right-hand roof by the first helicopter and pick up the Ascender.
Ride the zipline over the helicopter back and forth, killing enemies as you ride.

achievements.description: Complete the campaign
achievements.summary: Complete the @loc{Modern Warfare III} Campaign on any difficulty.

steps.text: Play through every mission to the end.

achievements.description: Complete the campaign on Veteran
achievements.summary: Complete the @loc{Modern Warfare III} Campaign on Veteran difficulty.

guide.context: Mission Select is fine if you finished missions earlier on a lower difficulty, but Veteran must be used for every mission.

steps.text: Play every mission on Veteran, using armor plates where available.

achievements.description: Kill 12 enemies while descending in the panopticon in 'Operation 627'
achievements.summary: Rappel down the panopticon in @loc{Operation 627} and kill 12 enemies on the way.

steps.text: While rappelling down the prison, kill 12 soldiers before the last window. Clear each floor before moving down.

achievements.description: Parachute off a Gantry Crane onto the roof of the Harbormaster's Building in 'Precious Cargo'
achievements.summary: In @loc{Precious Cargo}, jump from a Gantry Crane with the parachute and land on top of the Harbormaster's Building.

steps.text: Open the container in front of the spawn and take the parachute.
Climb the last crane on the right (south-east), wait until it swings near the control tower roof, then jump and open the parachute to land on that roof.

achievements.description: Destroy each objective helicopter in 'Reactor' with a different Armament
achievements.summary: In @loc{Reactor}, take out every objective helicopter, each with its own Armament.

guide.context: Do all three in one attempt of the mission.

steps.text: Use a Mortar Strike on the first helicopter (the yard left of the spawn has one).
Use the Precision Strike lying to the left of the south-east helicopter on that helicopter.
Use the Cruise Missile that lies short of the last helicopter, at a supply drop landing. Aim at the brown smoke and avoid the flying helicopter.

achievements.description: Using the EBR-14, kill 2 enemies with 1 bullet 5 times in 'Payload' without sounding the alarm
achievements.summary: In @loc{Payload}, with the EBR-14, score five single-bullet double kills and never sound the alarm.

guide.context: You start the mission with the EBR-14. If you are spotted, reload the checkpoint.

steps.text: Take the path on the left and stay crouched in tall grass.
Wait until two enemies stand close together, then kill both with one shot. Repeat for five double-kills, the last one in the main base courtyard.

achievements.description: Acquire the Major's keycard in 'Deep Cover' within 90 seconds without being detected
achievements.summary: In @loc{Deep Cover}, take the Major's keycard in 90 seconds or less while staying undetected.

guide.context: The checkpoint is just before the Major goes upstairs.

steps.text: Holster your weapon and walk, taking the open building as a shortcut, to the Admin Building parking lot behind the last patrolling guard.
Wait for the Major to leave, follow him upstairs and take him down at the top of the stairs before he enters the room.
Pick up his keycard.

achievements.description: Shoot the gun out of the air in 'Flashpoint' before a terrorist catches it
achievements.summary: In Modern Warfare III's Flashpoint mission, hit the rifle with a shot while it is flying between two fake paramedics.

guide.context: Reload the checkpoint to retry as often as needed.

steps.text: In @loc{Flashpoint}, enter the room with the fake paramedics. Do not help the man on the right and do not walk up to the others.
Stand still while Price questions them. About 25 seconds later, the man at the back right throws an assault rifle to the man on the left.
Aim slightly above the door handles and shoot the rifle with one shot while it is in the air.

achievements.description: Destroy all of the cars in the mansion garage in 'Oligarch'
achievements.summary: In Modern Warfare III's Oligarch mission, blow up every car parked in the mansion garage.

guide.context: You can do this at any time in the mission. An ammo box sits inside the garage.

steps.text: In @loc{Oligarch}, go to the garage left of the mansion's front entrance, in the north of the map.
Blow up all 6 cars by shooting them or throwing explosives.

achievements.description: Reach the roof in 'Highrise' under 45 seconds
achievements.summary: In Modern Warfare III's Highrise mission, get to the roof within 45 seconds of the start.

guide.context: The Ascender is needed; the timed run is not possible without it. Equip a pistol to run faster.

steps.text: In @loc{Highrise}, go up to the 11th floor and open the box by the stairwell at the end of that floor to get the Ascender.
Use the pause menu to restart the mission, so you begin with the Ascender equipped.
Go up the rope inside the first elevator shaft. Beat the two enemies in the following corridor, then go up the rope at its far end.
Turn left, climb out of the window and ride the zipline, then the second zipline. The achievement unlocks on reaching the roof; if not, climb the next ladder.

achievements.description: Execute the forest sniper in 'Frozen Tundra' with a takedown
achievements.summary: In Modern Warfare III's Frozen Tundra mission, kill the sniper in the woods with a melee takedown.

guide.context: The takedown only works when the Takedown prompt shows at the top of the screen. If the sniper dies another way, restart the checkpoint before it saves.

steps.text: In @loc{Frozen Tundra}, wait for the sniper in white to attack in the snowy woods.
Throw a flashbang at him or shoot until his armor breaks, then run up and melee him until the Takedown prompt appears.
Hold the melee button to perform the takedown.

achievements.description: Defuse the bomb on the truck in 'Gora Dam' while it is in motion
achievements.summary: In Modern Warfare III's Gora Dam mission, disarm the bomb on the truck while the truck is still driving.

guide.context: If the enemies spot you, the truck stops. Parachuting in keeps you unseen.

steps.text: When @loc{Gora Dam} starts, parachute onto the rear of the truck driving along the right edge of the map.
Crouch after landing and hold the interact button to defuse the bomb.

achievements.description: Use a missile to take out a single enemy in 'Danger Close'
achievements.summary: In Modern Warfare III's Danger Close mission, kill one lone enemy with a missile.

steps.text: At the start of @loc{Danger Close}, switch the gunship weapon to Missile and fire at one enemy in the boneyard.

achievements.description: Reach Level 55
achievements.summary: Reach Level 55 in Modern Warfare III.

guide.context: Level is shared between Modern Warfare III Multiplayer and MWZ, so MWZ kills count. XP boosters speed it up.

steps.text: Gain XP in MWZ or Multiplayer until you reach Level 55.
If the achievement does not unlock in MWZ, play one Multiplayer match.

achievements.description: Successfully Exfil in MWZ
achievements.summary: Successfully exfil in MWZ.

steps.text: Open the map and go to the exfil icon, defend until the helicopter arrives, then board it and let it fly away.

achievements.description: Kill 500 Enemies using an Insured Weapon in MWZ
achievements.summary: Get 500 kills in MWZ with a weapon from your insured slot.

steps.text: Before a match, open Gear in the MWZ menu, pick a weapon in Insured Slot 1 and equip it to a gear slot. The red word Contraband should disappear.
Use that weapon to kill 500 enemies in total.

achievements.description: Have 9 perks active at the same time in MWZ
achievements.summary: Hold all 9 MWZ perks at once.

guide.context: The perks are Quick Revive, Jugger-Nog, Speed Cola, Stamin-Up, Phd Flopper, Deadshot Daiquiri, Death Perception, Elemental Pop and Tombstone Soda.

steps.text: Over several matches, exfil with one of each Perk-a-Cola in your rucksack, then unequip them in Gear to store them in the stash. The stash holds up to 10 items.
Take the stored drinks into a match. Buy the Perk-a-Colas you are missing from machines on the map first.
Then drink the stored ones so all 9 perks are active together.

achievements.description: Kill 100 Zombies with a vehicle in a single deployment in MWZ
achievements.summary: Run over 100 zombies with a vehicle during one MWZ match.

guide.context: A smoking vehicle is close to exploding. Stop at a fuel station to repair and refuel, and leave the vehicle to fight while it recharges.

steps.text: Drive a vehicle into zombies until you have 100 vehicle kills before the match ends.

achievements.description: Reclaim your gear from a Tombstone in MWZ
achievements.summary: Pick up the gear you dropped when you died, by looting your Tombstone in MWZ.

steps.text: In a match, buy Tombstone Soda for 2000 points. Its machine is marked on the map.
Die and bleed out, then leave the match from the Options menu.
In your next match, go to the tombstone icon where you died and loot the tombstone.

achievements.description: Revive a player from a different Squad in MWZ
achievements.summary: Bring a downed player from another squad back up in MWZ.

guide.context: Playing solo, with Squad Fill off, stops teammates taking revives from you.

steps.text: Find other squads on the map, shown as blue arrows, or go to a Plea for Help icon.
Stay close until one of them goes down, then revive that player before anyone else can.

achievements.description: Pet a Hellhound in MWZ
achievements.summary: Pet a Hellhound in MWZ.

guide.context: Chunks of Flesh drop at random from zombies and vanish when you exfil, so spend them first. Some Hellhounds give no pet prompt; try another Doghouse or hand in 2 Chunks of Flesh at once.

steps.text: Get a Chunk of Flesh from a zombie. Calling the exfil helicopter and clearing the zombies repeatedly is one way to farm it.
Take it to a Doghouse on the map. Doghouses appear on the map once you get near them.
Interact with the friendly Hellhound that spawns when the pet prompt appears.

achievements.description: Complete 20 Contracts in MWZ
achievements.summary: Complete 20 Contracts in MWZ.

steps.text: Tag blue Contract icons on the map, go to each one, find where it starts and finish it. Do this 20 times.

achievements.description: Complete 5 Contracts in the High Threat Zone in a single deployment in MWZ
achievements.summary: Finish 5 Contracts inside the High Threat Zone during one MWZ match.

guide.context: The High Threat Zone is the red inner city, Tier III. A game over resets your count, so a new match must start from zero.

steps.text: Earn 5,000 points on Tier 1 contracts, then buy a legendary wallbuy weapon in the Tier III zone and Pack-a-Punch it to Level 2.
In the High Threat Zone, complete 5 contracts. Vehicle Delivery contracts are the easiest and respawn after completion.
To make it easier, hold the squad-menu button near other squads and choose Invite or Request to Join to form a squad of up to 6.

achievements.description: Complete Act III in MWZ
achievements.summary: Complete Act III in MWZ.

guide.context: You can also earn this by joining a player who has unlocked the Orcus fight and defeating Orcus with them.

steps.text: In the MWZ main menu, open Story Missions and select a mission. Only the selected mission earns progress.
Keep finishing missions to advance from Act I to Act II and then Act III.
Complete the final Act III mission by defeating Orcus.

achievements.description: Kill 50,000 total Enemies in MWZ
achievements.summary: Reach 50,000 total kills in MWZ, counting zombies and humans.

guide.context: Check your total in the MWZ Start Menu under Options, Stats, Zombies, Kills. Stats take about 2 minutes to update after a match.

steps.text: Kill zombies and humans in MWZ matches. Finishing the Acts gives about half the kills.
To farm faster, start OUTLAST contracts and do not finish them, so zombies keep spawning.

achievements.description: Defeat a Warlord in MWZ
achievements.summary: Defeat a Warlord in MWZ.

guide.context: The Warlord is called Legacy in-game. Land at least one hit on him, as every squadmate must do to get credit.

steps.text: Obtain a Mercenary Stronghold Keycard by looting a Mercenary Camp chest, paying 2000 points at a Buy Station, or beating a Mercenary Convoy.
Open a Mercenary Stronghold with it, clear it, and drill the safe. Take the Fortress Keycard - Legacy.
Head to the Legacy Fortress, which tends to appear in the north-west part of Tier II, and clear the enemies around it.
Open the door with the keycard, clear the inside, and defeat Legacy, the last enemy.

achievements.description: Kill Orcus while in a 6-person squad in MWZ
achievements.summary: Defeat Orcus in MWZ while your squad has 6 players.

guide.context: Joining a player who already unlocked Orcus also works; you do not need to finish the Acts yourself.

steps.text: Stand near another squad and hold the squad-menu button. Choose the option to invite nearby players or to ask to join a nearby squad, until you have 6 players.
Have a player with Act III unlocked start the Orcus fight, and defeat Orcus together.

achievements.description: Complete the Campaign on any difficulty
achievements.summary: Complete the Black Ops 6 Campaign on any difficulty.

steps.text: Finish all 11 missions of the campaign, ending with @loc{Checkmate}.

achievements.description: Complete the Campaign on Veteran difficulty
achievements.summary: Complete the Black Ops 6 Campaign on Veteran difficulty.

guide.context: Safehouse and player upgrades carry over to later runs, so buy them before this run.

steps.text: Set the difficulty to Veteran, the hardest setting, and finish all 11 missions.

achievements.description: Complete Bishop Takes Rook in Campaign on any difficulty
achievements.summary: Complete Bishop Takes Rook in the Black Ops 6 Campaign on any difficulty.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Bishop Takes Rook}, the first mission.

achievements.description: Complete Blood Feud in Campaign on any difficulty
achievements.summary: Complete Blood Feud in the Black Ops 6 Campaign on any difficulty.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Blood Feud}, the second mission.

achievements.description: Complete Most Wanted in Campaign on any difficulty
achievements.summary: Complete Most Wanted in the Black Ops 6 Campaign on any difficulty.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Most Wanted}, the third mission.

achievements.description: Complete Hunting Season and The Cradle in Campaign on any difficulty
achievements.summary: Finish both Hunting Season and The Cradle in the Black Ops 6 Campaign, on any difficulty.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Hunting Season}, the fourth mission, then finish @loc{The Cradle}. The achievement unlocks after The Cradle.

achievements.description: Complete Emergence in Campaign on any difficulty
achievements.summary: Complete Emergence in the Black Ops 6 Campaign on any difficulty.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Emergence}, the sixth mission.

achievements.description: Complete High Rollers in Campaign on any difficulty
achievements.summary: Complete High Rollers in the Black Ops 6 Campaign on any difficulty.

steps.text: Finish @loc{High Rollers}, the seventh mission.

achievements.description: Complete Ground Control in Campaign on any difficulty
achievements.summary: Complete Ground Control in the Black Ops 6 Campaign on any difficulty.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Ground Control}, the eighth mission.

achievements.description: Complete Under the Radar in Campaign on any difficulty
achievements.summary: Complete Under the Radar in the Black Ops 6 Campaign on any difficulty.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Under the Radar}, the ninth mission.

achievements.description: Complete Separation Anxiety in Campaign on any difficulty
achievements.summary: Complete Separation Anxiety in the Black Ops 6 Campaign on any difficulty.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Separation Anxiety}, the tenth mission.

achievements.description: Complete Checkmate in Campaign on any difficulty
achievements.summary: Complete Checkmate in the Black Ops 6 Campaign on any difficulty.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Checkmate}, the eleventh and final mission.

achievements.description: In Blood Feud, reach the Guild meeting without ever breaking stealth
achievements.summary: Reach the Guild meeting in the Blood Feud mission without being detected once.

guide.context: Killing a guard at once does not alert the others. If guards start shooting, reload the last checkpoint.

steps.text: Quietly remove the few guards on the right side, then enter by the second story window.
Deal with a couple more guards, climb the tower to snipe your target, and exit by the same window.
Take out the guard on the nearest bridge, swim the canal back to the van and get in.
At the next location, enter the right kitchen door after the guard who exits is dealt with. Remove the two guards inside and the two upstairs.
Wait and sneak past in the restaurant, then enter the room on the right.

achievements.description: In Most Wanted, perform 5 takedowns on guards in the gala without being spotted
achievements.summary: In the Most Wanted gala, take down 5 guards without anyone spotting you.

guide.context: Guards wander up to the curtained side rooms with their backs turned. Marking them with the camera shows them through walls.

steps.text: In the gala of @loc{Most Wanted}, wait in a curtained side room and take down a guard who comes close. Start with the guard at the coat rack.
Hide each body fully, then repeat until you have 5 takedowns without being spotted.

achievements.description: In Hunting Season, complete every POI on the Tac Map
achievements.summary: In the Hunting Season mission, finish all the marked points of interest on the Tac Map.

guide.context: Talk to Captain Gladney until his dialogue is exhausted. He adds more points of interest to your map.

steps.text: Before leaving camp, finish all dialogue with Captain Gladney.
Complete every point of interest marked on the Tac Map, including destroying all the Scud Launchers.

achievements.description: In Under the Radar, have the SAM target itself and the helicopter
achievements.summary: In Under the Radar, make the SAM site target itself and the enemy helicopter.

guide.context: One hack handles both. If you shoot the enemy helicopter yourself while controlling Case, the achievement fails.

steps.text: Climb the ladder to the rooftop unseen and hack the computer inside with the code ICARUS IFF.
Go to the SAM computer in the nearby building and deal with the 3 enemies inside.
Enter the cipher ORION TARGET and pick the option that targets the SAM site to itself and the helicopter, not the SAM site only.
Deal with the radar, then hack the cameras with PANOPTES. As Case in the helicopter, do not shoot the enemy helicopter; the SAM destroys both.

achievements.description: In Ground Control, crush 25 enemies while driving the tank
achievements.summary: In the Ground Control mission, run over 25 enemies with the tank you drive.

steps.text: Once you reach the plane cockpit and move on to the tarmac, climb into the tank.
Chase enemy groups and drive over 25 enemies. Run over cover that hides them.

achievements.description: In Checkmate, destroy the APC using an RC-XD
achievements.summary: In the Checkmate mission, take down the APC with an RC-XD explosion.

guide.context: If the APC dies without the achievement, a checkpoint is already saved, so restart Checkmate.

steps.text: Before the fight, pick up the RC-XD behind the first wall outside the front door.
When the APC arrives after the third wave, weaken it with two rocket launcher hits and gunfire until it burns.
Drive the RC-XD to the APC's rear bumper and detonate it by hand with the fire button. Do not let it explode on its own.

achievements.description: Purchase all Safehouse and Player Upgrades in Campaign
achievements.summary: Buy every upgrade for the Safehouse and for your player in the Black Ops 6 Campaign.

guide.context: Safes open only once, but you can replay missions and collect money piles again. Safehouse upgrade progress is saved outside your campaign run.

steps.text: Collect money from piles and safes in missions, and open every safe on your first run.
Between missions, buy the 3 upgrade stations first (Weapons Bench, Gear Station, Training Area), then every upgrade.
If short on money, restart @loc{High Rollers} and pick up the money piles on the tables before the first objective.

achievements.description: Complete all Safehouse Puzzles in Campaign
achievements.summary: Complete all 8 Safehouse Puzzles in the Black Ops 6 Campaign.

guide.context: Do the puzzles before you start Separation Anxiety; after that the Safehouse is under siege. Save before that mission if puzzles remain.

steps.text: Pick up the Blacklight in the Safehouse after the first mission.
Piano: in the piano room, read the notes on the walls with the Blacklight and play Mn, Pe, Cn, Ao, Pe.
Boiler Room: in the basement, turn the middle valve twice, the left valve once, press the button once, then turn the middle valve twice.
Keypad: go down into the basement and turn right. Crack the 5-digit code; matching digits are marked as in campaign decrypting.
Computer: after the keypad, pass the door at the far end of that room to reach the computer. Enter HOLDING, ROOM, BUNKER and OPEN in the order the game asks.
Lockpick: go back into the main bunker passage and enter the newly opened door near the end. Pick the lock 3 times and take the KEY from the room.

Radio: go to the door across from the keypad and use the radio on the half bookshelf. Match the wavelength and amplitude, then listen for the 4 objects in the message. Find each object in the room and read its number with the Blacklight, in the order the message names them.
Safe: enter that code in the second-floor bedroom safe.

achievements.description: Get 2 Kills with a single remote controlled Throwing Knife from at least 50 meters away in Campaign
achievements.summary: In the Black Ops 6 Campaign, kill 2 enemies with one steered throwing knife thrown from at least 50 meters.

guide.context: You need a homing throwing knife.

steps.text: At the start of @loc{Checkmate}, wait until enemies throw smoke, then back up to the Safehouse front door.
Throw a homing knife, steer it to the back of the group, and detonate it between two close enemies.

achievements.description: Get 5 Headshot Kills during a single use of the Adrenaline Stim in Campaign
achievements.summary: In the Black Ops 6 Campaign, land 5 headshot kills in the time of one Adrenaline Stim.

guide.context: Missed shots are fine. Pick weak, unarmored enemies and use a good sniper rifle.

steps.text: In @loc{High Rollers}, take the Adrenaline Shot from the stash on the left before the shield enemies, or bring a stim into @loc{Most Wanted} or @loc{Checkmate}.
Use the stim and get 5 headshot kills before it ends.

achievements.description: Perform 10 takedowns in Campaign
achievements.summary: Perform 10 takedowns in the Black Ops 6 Campaign.

guide.context: Holding the takedown key takes an enemy hostage instead of a quick takedown.

steps.text: Sneak up behind enemies in the first two missions and tap the takedown key until you reach 10.

achievements.description: Get 5 or more Kills with a single Scorestreak in Campaign
achievements.summary: In the Black Ops 6 Campaign, kill at least 5 enemies with one Scorestreak.

guide.context: RC-XDs also appear in supply drops in Hunting Season.

steps.text: In @loc{Hunting Season}, help the crashed helicopter southeast of the starting base to get the Stealth Bomber.
Use it on the biggest group of enemies for 5 kills.

achievements.description: Enter Prestige 1
achievements.summary: Enter Prestige 1 in Black Ops 6.

guide.context: You must reach level 55 first.

steps.text: Earn XP in Black Ops 6 until you reach level 55, then enter Prestige 1.

achievements.description: Earn a Mastery Badge for any weapon
achievements.summary: Earn the gold Mastery Badge on any one Black Ops 6 weapon.

steps.text: Pick one weapon and finish its Mastery Badge challenges. The first (gold) badge is the one that counts.

achievements.description: Unlock any Diamond or Opal Camo
achievements.summary: Unlock any Diamond or Opal camo in Black Ops 6.

guide.context: Diamond is the Multiplayer camo and Opal is the Zombies one. You only need one of them.

steps.text: Pick a weapon class with few guns, such as Snipers or Shotguns, which have only 2 guns each.
On each gun in the class, unlock the military camos, then the special camos, then the Gold camo (Mystic Gold in Zombies).
When every gun in the class has Gold, the Diamond or Opal camo unlocks.

achievements.description: Get 500 Eliminations in Multiplayer
achievements.summary: Get 500 Eliminations in Black Ops 6 Multiplayer.

steps.text: Play Black Ops 6 Multiplayer matches until your eliminations reach 500.

achievements.description: Win 25 Multiplayer Matches
achievements.summary: Win 25 Multiplayer matches in Black Ops 6.

steps.text: Win 25 Multiplayer matches. Hardcore Moshpit matches end fast.

achievements.description: Get a Double Kill with the RC-XD in Multiplayer
achievements.summary: Kill two enemies at once with an RC-XD in Black Ops 6 Multiplayer.

steps.text: Equip the RC-XD Scorestreak and earn it in a match.
Drive it into a spot where enemies gather, such as the Hardpoint zone or a lane near their spawn, and detonate it next to two enemies.

achievements.description: Get featured in the Best Play 3 times in Multiplayer
achievements.summary: In 3 Black Ops 6 Multiplayer matches, get picked as the featured Best Play.

guide.context: Get your kills with guns and lethals, not Scorestreaks.

steps.text: Play aggressively and chain quick multi-kills so your play is the one shown at the end of the match.
Repeat until you have been featured 3 times.

achievements.description: Complete the Training Course in Multiplayer
achievements.summary: Complete the Training Course in Black Ops 6 Multiplayer.

steps.text: In Multiplayer open Find a Match, then Training Course at the bottom, and play every station.
Perform the emote when the course prompts for it.

achievements.description: Kill an enemy from behind at close range while disguised by the Sleeper Agent
achievements.summary: While disguised by Sleeper Agent in Black Ops 6 Multiplayer, sneak up on an enemy and kill them from behind at short range.

guide.context: Sleeper Agent is a field upgrade that unlocks at level 51.

steps.text: Equip the Sleeper Agent field upgrade and charge it.
Activate it while hidden and sneak up behind an enemy.
Hold melee to execute them.

achievements.description: Destroy 50 Aerial Scorestreaks with Launchers in Multiplayer
achievements.summary: Use launchers to destroy 50 aerial Scorestreaks in Black Ops 6 Multiplayer.

guide.context: Aerial Scorestreaks are UAVs, Counter UAVs and helicopters. Helicopters are the easiest to hit.

steps.text: Equip a launcher as your secondary weapon.
Shoot down every aerial Scorestreak that appears until you reach 50. The CIGMA 2B launcher can lock on.

achievements.description: Get 75 Eliminations while having an active Combat Speciality Perk in Multiplayer
achievements.summary: Get 75 Eliminations in Black Ops 6 Multiplayer while a Combat Specialty perk is active.

guide.context: You get a Combat Specialty perk by equipping 3 perks of the same color.

steps.text: Equip three perks of one color. The earliest option is the green perks at level 11, which give Strategist.
Play Multiplayer until you have 75 eliminations with it active.

achievements.description: Complete the Terminus main Easter Egg.
achievements.summary: Complete the Terminus main Easter Egg in Black Ops 6 Zombies.

guide.context: Crafting the Beamsmasher is part of the quest. Solo play is hard without Cymbal Monkeys and Idle Eyes.

steps.text: Turn on the power, then turn on the three computers X, Y and Z in that order.
Shoot the five fuseboxes in order with a bullet weapon that has the Dead Wire ammo mod. Use the Pack-a-Punch lift to line up the shots.
In the lab, take the EMF Fob from the zombie under the shelf and the Multiphasic Resonator from the briefcase in the Elemental Pop room.
Plug the Resonator into the workshop computer, enter the 6-digit code (or pay Peck 5,000 essence for it), and craft the Beamsmasher.
Find the tentacle trap with the broken vent and put the Hard Drive in the slot. Enter the 3-digit code on the Bio Lab Containment Unit, then turn the valves and defeat Nathan.
Pick up the Keycard from the ocean floor where Nathan fell and use it at the black-screen computer in the Communications room.
Drive the boat into the Shipwreck hull, climb the ladder and take the Node Connector. Place Node Connectors at the three sockets (West caves, Docks, Southernmost Island); one is already filled.
Collect the Hacking Device from Peck, then hack the three Water Satellites by boat within 2 minutes of the first hack.
Return to the Bio Lab and defuse the three bombs in the wall compartments within 5 minutes.
Fight Patient 13 in the open door next to Melee Macchiato. Hide behind boxes or in the water when he powers up blue, then kill him.

achievements.description: In Terminus, consume a fish cooked with a special ingredient
achievements.summary: In Terminus, eat a fish you cooked with a special ingredient.

guide.context: The round must end while the fish cooks.

steps.text: Turn on the power, then take the Cooking Oil from the Mess Hall kitchen.
Blow up a pink fish near a shore with an explosive. Do it in the Pack-a-Punch room for the easiest one.
Collect one special ingredient, such as Chili, Battery, Mushroom, Salt or Brain.
In the kitchen, put the items in the frying pan, end the round, then take the cooked fish.

achievements.description: In Terminus, find the final Talisman
achievements.summary: In Terminus, find the Cursed Talisman.

guide.context: The talisman gives permanent double points but costs essence whenever a zombie hits you, so avoid doing this during a run you care about.

steps.text: Turn on the power, buy Melee Macchiato in the Pack-a-Punch area and punch open the wall opposite Speed Cola in the Sea Caves.
Take the gold watch from the ocean floor at the marked spot and give it to the skeleton pirate Captain in the caves. Three more spots are marked.
Burn the bones at Castle Rock Island, the Shipwreck and Temple Island with a Molotov or thermal grenade. Beat the boss that spawns at each and take its Cursed Coin.
Give the three Cursed Coins to the Captain.
Go to Crab Island and survive three rounds.
Open the chest that appears in the middle of the island.

achievements.description: Complete the Liberty Falls main Easter Egg.
achievements.summary: Complete the Liberty Falls main Easter Egg in Black Ops 6 Zombies.

guide.context: Have at least one Pack-a-Punched gun, Juggernog and a few perks, and ideally two players with Quick Revive for the final fight.

steps.text: Unlock the Church for Pack-a-Punch and get the Thrustodyne M23, by crafting it or from the Mystery Box.

Start the quest at the SDG generator inside the Church. Use the Thrustodyne M23 to suck up the Hat (Church by Panos), the Canister (Comic store roof) and the Gear (Buzz's Cuts window above Speed Cola).
Unlock the Savings and Loans roof and craft the L.T.G. Device at the workbench.
Carry the Aether Canister from the Church generator to the trap by Speed Cola on Hill St.
Place the L.T.G. Device at the purple storm in the Cemetery and hold off zombies at the portal until an Elite Zombie appears.
Weaken the Elite Zombie, lure it to the trap holding the canister, and finish it off inside the purple cloud.
Return the filled canister to the Church generator within 1:30 and take the Strauss Counter.
Use the Strauss Counter at three projectors and set each to the opposite color: Red to Green, Green to Red, Yellow to Yellow.
Repeat the same tuning and Elite kill at the purple storm in front of the spawn Mystery Box spot, then bring the canister to the SDG generator again.
Start the final fight at the Church generator and kill the Abomination in the last wave.

achievements.description: In Liberty Falls, tap into your Supervillain side
achievements.summary: In Liberty Falls, collect every Aetherella figurine to transform into Aetherella.

guide.context: You need the Thrustodyne M23 wonder weapon first. Leave the last figurine for a hard round or an exfil, since the transformation lasts a full round.

steps.text: Get the Thrustodyne M23 by crafting it or from the Mystery Box. The Hidden Power Ultra GobbleGum gives an even chance at the Thrustodyne M23 or the Ray Gun from the box.

Suck up all 9 Aetherella figurines with the Thrustodyne M23. Start at the Bowling Alley, then the Church, then the roofs of Speed Cola and the Bank. Finish at Spawn and the Arcade. The comic store has some too.
Collecting the last figurine turns you into Aetherella for the round.

achievements.description: In Liberty Falls, achieve a sporting high score
achievements.summary: In Liberty Falls, score 300 in the bowling mini-game.

guide.context: If you miss 300, the mini-game can be restarted after a while.

steps.text: Shoot all 5 pairs of bowling shoes: the gas station building at spawn, Frank's Hardware, a house on the hill to the Church, the far end of the Cemetery by the Tier 3 armor on the tree, and the Benson Burial Services coffin opposite the Bowling Alley.
After the fifth pair, everyone teleports to the bowling alley. Fully charge the ball and roll it into lanes with many zombies until you reach 300 points.

achievements.description: Get 100 Kills while using Mutant Injections in Zombies
achievements.summary: Get 100 kills in Black Ops 6 Zombies while using Mutant Injections.

guide.context: Mutant Injections turn you into a Mangler for a short time. Any Mangler attack on zombies counts.

steps.text: Get Mutant Injections. Manglers can drop them, or you can spend 2,500 salvage to make one at a Crafting Table.
Use one on a high round and kill zombies with the Mangler attacks. Repeat until you reach 100 kills.

achievements.description: Research all Augments for 10 Items in Zombies
achievements.summary: Finish researching every Augment on 10 different items in Black Ops 6 Zombies.

guide.context: You need level 11. Equip a minor and a major augment on each item you research.

steps.text: Open Weapons, then Augments, then Research Augments, and start research on an item. Only one item researches at a time.
Earn XP in Zombies matches until all 6 tiers are done for that item. Repeat for 10 items.

achievements.description: Get 100 Elite Zombie Eliminations in Zombies
achievements.summary: Get 100 Elite Zombie eliminations in Black Ops 6 Zombies.

guide.context: Elite Zombies such as Abominations and Amalgams start appearing around Round 16.

steps.text: Play high rounds in Zombies, where Elite Zombies appear in growing numbers, and kill them until you reach 100.

achievements.description: Enter Prestige in Black Ops 7
achievements.summary: Enter Prestige in Black Ops 7.

guide.context: You must reach level 55 first. Prestige resets your gear, so finish camo and Zombies tasks you want first.

steps.text: Earn XP in Multiplayer or Zombies until you reach level 55, then enter Prestige in Career, then Progression, then Prestige.

achievements.description: Earn any Arclight, Moonstone, or Bloodstone Camo
achievements.summary: Unlock one Arclight, Moonstone or Bloodstone camo in Black Ops 7.

guide.context: Arclight is Multiplayer, Moonstone is Co-Op Campaign and Bloodstone is Zombies. You only need one. Zombies camos are generally easiest and also count toward Mastery Badges.

steps.text: Pick a weapon class with only 2 weapons: Melee Weapons, Rocket Launchers or LMGs.
Earn the Gold camo on every weapon in that class in one mode.
The matching Arclight, Moonstone or Bloodstone camo then unlocks.

achievements.description: Enter Weapon Prestige with any Weapon
achievements.summary: Enter Weapon Prestige with any weapon in Black Ops 7.

steps.text: Get kills with one weapon in any mode until it reaches max level.
Select the weapon in the loadout, then hold the Prestige Available button to enter Weapon Prestige 1.

achievements.description: Earn Diamond Badges for any category of Mastery Badges
achievements.summary: Reach the Diamond level in one category of Mastery Badges in Black Ops 7.

guide.context: Multiplayer and Zombies track Mastery separately. Co-Op Campaign has no Mastery Badges.

steps.text: In Loadouts Customization, select a weapon and switch from Stats to Mastery to see its challenges.
Finish the challenges across a weapon category until the Diamond badge for that category is earned.

achievements.description: Earn 100 unique Medals across Multiplayer or Zombies
achievements.summary: Earn 100 different Medals across Black Ops 7 Multiplayer or Zombies.

guide.context: The 100 Medals must be different types. Multiplayer and Zombies each have more than 100, so one mode is enough.

steps.text: Play Multiplayer or Zombies and earn different Medals. Check Career, then Stats, then Medal Collection to see which ones are left.
If you are short after other tasks, work through the easiest Medals in that menu.

achievements.description: Equip an Overclock on a Lethal, Tactical, Field Upgrade and 3 Scorestreaks at once
achievements.summary: Equip an Overclock on a Lethal, a Tactical, a Field Upgrade and 3 Scorestreaks at the same time.

steps.text: Open Multiplayer, then Find a Match, then Private, and create a private match, where everything is unlocked.
In Loadouts, put an Overclock on your Lethal, Tactical and Field Upgrade, and on all 3 Scorestreaks in the Scorestreaks menu. The achievement unlocks as you equip them.

achievements.description: Win 25 Multiplayer Matches
achievements.summary: Win 25 Multiplayer matches in Black Ops 7.

steps.text: Win 25 Multiplayer matches of any mode. Team wins count. Career, then Stats, then Combat Record shows your wins.

achievements.description: Get 1000 Eliminations in Multiplayer
achievements.summary: Get 1000 Eliminations in Black Ops 7 Multiplayer.

steps.text: Get 1000 eliminations across Multiplayer modes. Career, then Stats, then Combat Record shows your total.

achievements.description: Get featured in the Best Play 3 times
achievements.summary: In 3 Black Ops 7 Multiplayer matches, get picked as the featured Best Play.

steps.text: Play aggressively and string kills together quickly so you are the one shown in the Best Play scene at the end of the match.
Repeat until you have been featured 3 times. Shotguns on small maps and the Stimshot tactical help.

achievements.description: Complete all 6 Calling Card Challenges in any Multiplayer Category
achievements.summary: Finish all 6 Calling Card challenges within one Black Ops 7 Multiplayer category.

guide.context: Each subcategory has exactly 6 challenges. Career, then Bootcamp is the easiest.

steps.text: Open Multiplayer, then Career, then Challenges, then Calling Cards, and pick a category.
Finish all 6 challenges in it, such as getting 100 eliminations or winning 3 matches.

achievements.description: Kill your Nemesis 10 times
achievements.summary: Kill your Nemesis 10 times in Black Ops 7 Multiplayer.

guide.context: An opponent who kills you repeatedly becomes your Nemesis and gets a red crosshair on their name.

steps.text: Play until a player becomes your Nemesis, then kill players who have the red crosshair. Repeat to reach 10 kills.

achievements.description: Get 100 Eliminations while having an active Combat Hybrid Perk in Multiplayer
achievements.summary: Get 100 Eliminations in Black Ops 7 Multiplayer with a Combat Hybrid perk active.

guide.context: Equip perks from exactly 2 colors, 2 of one color and 1 of another.

steps.text: Equip two perks of one color and one perk of a second color to activate Tactician, Scout or Operative.
Get 100 eliminations in Multiplayer while it is active.

achievements.description: Call in 50 Scorestreaks in Multiplayer
achievements.summary: Call in 50 Scorestreaks in Black Ops 7 Multiplayer.

guide.context: Low-cost Scorestreaks let you call more of them.

steps.text: Equip Scorestreaks that need little score, such as the UAV and Counter UAV.
Earn and call in Scorestreaks over many matches until you reach 50.

achievements.description: Destroy 5 items with the Hunter Bot in a single match
achievements.summary: Use the Hunter Bot to destroy 5 enemy items in a single Black Ops 7 Multiplayer match.

guide.context: Hunter Bot is a Tactical unlocked at level 42. It goes after enemy gear, Field Upgrades and Scorestreaks.

steps.text: Equip the Hunter Bot as your Tactical. The Tac Expert wildcard gives an extra one.
Throw it straight up so it targets enemy UAVs and Counter UAVs, and destroy 5 in one match. The first Overclock helps it one-shot UAVs.

achievements.description: Get 3 Kills while defending an Objective Zone without leaving it
achievements.summary: Kill 3 enemies in Black Ops 7 Multiplayer while defending an Objective Zone and never leaving it.

steps.text: Open Quickplay, filter, and enable only Domination and Hardpoint.
Stay inside one objective zone and kill 3 enemies there.

achievements.description: Complete the Black Ops 7 Training Course
achievements.summary: Finish the Training Course in Black Ops 7.

steps.text: Open Multiplayer, then Find a Match, then Training Course, and finish all 6 stations.

achievements.description: Get a Direct Hit Kill from at least 30 meters away with the Needle Drone.
achievements.summary: Kill an enemy with a Needle Drone direct hit from 30 meters or farther in Black Ops 7 Multiplayer.

guide.context: Needle Drone is a Lethal unlocked at level 18. A private match makes this easier.

steps.text: Equip the Needle Drone as your Lethal. The Danger Close wildcard gives an extra one.
Launch it from 30 meters or more at the enemy spawn or at a Domination or Hardpoint zone. You can steer it by hand to hit.

achievements.description: Get 3 Kills with a single use of the Gravemaker Scorestreak
achievements.summary: Get 3 kills with one use of the Gravemaker Scorestreak in Black Ops 7 Multiplayer.

guide.context: Gravemaker unlocks at level 17 and costs 1000 score. Its shots go through walls and kill in one hit, and the 3 kills can be separate shots.

steps.text: Equip Gravemaker, plus UAV and Counter UAV for cheap score.
When it is ready, aim to see the red outlines of enemies and charge each shot. Fire at the enemy spawn or an objective zone, and get 3 kills before it runs out.
Option: equip Care Package and Gravemaker with Bankroll and reroll the Care Package until it holds Gravemaker.

achievements.description: Get a Kill while airborne from a wallhop
achievements.summary: In Black Ops 7 Multiplayer, kill an enemy while you are in the air after a wallhop.

steps.text: Jump against a wall, then tap jump again to leap off it.
Kill an enemy while you are in the air.

achievements.description: Complete the Main Quest in Ashes Of The Damned
achievements.summary: Finish the main quest of Ashes of the Damned in Black Ops 7 Zombies.

guide.context: You first need Ol' Tessie's Abomination Head Hood and DG-2 Turret upgrades and the Necrofluid Gauntlet. Directed Mode also unlocks it and is easier.

steps.text: Enter the rooftop symbols to open the Cube in the Vandorn Farm basement. Build the Necrofluid Gauntlet from it.
Add the Abomination Head Hood and DG-2 Turret to Ol' Tessie.
Get Widow's Lantern: take a Jar of Spores from the shack kitchen or the horse corpse at Vandorn Farm. Wait 3 rounds.
Get Devourer's Eyes: kill the Devourer with the spike trap.
Get Human Bones: hit the hanging corpse in the barn with a Combat Axe, then hit its leg with a Molotov.
Get Keeper's Shards: hit the purple crystals in the fog with the Gauntlet beam attack.
Get Mysterious Limb: in Round 16, kill the Zsursa Bear with Ol' Tessie.
Get Powder of the Forgotten: buy the Tea Spirit perk, use the mirror in the Ashwood Atelier, then shoot the ghost.
At Yuri's Laboratory in Zarya Cosmodrome, solve the three Pigpen Ciphers, place the ingredients in order, then add your blood and survive.
Charge the Gauntlet by shooting the Clock Tower above Ashwood with the DG-2 Turret to stop it, then shooting the clock face with the Gauntlet and pulling it back.
With a charged Gauntlet, free the souls at Vandorn Farm first, then Zarya Cosmodrome, Exit 115 and Blackwater Lake House.
Drive Ol' Tessie through the red smoking orbs at the Forest of Monoliths, Collapsed Tower, Shipwreck and Abandoned Cabins to reach the Tomb of Veytarion.
Ram the boss with the boost and ramp to reveal weak points, and drive through electrical pillars to break its shield.

achievements.description: Eliminate 10,000 Zombies
achievements.summary: Eliminate 10,000 Zombies in Black Ops 7 Zombies.

steps.text: Kill zombies in Zombies matches until your total reaches 10,000. Zombies, then Career, then Stats, then Combat Record shows your count.

achievements.description: Reach Round 30 on a Survival Map
achievements.summary: Reach Round 30 on a Black Ops 7 Zombies Survival map.

guide.context: You can play solo or with Squad Fill.

steps.text: Choose Zombies, then Select Match, then Survival, and survive until Round 30 starts.

achievements.description: Unlock 3 Relics in Ashes of the Damned
achievements.summary: Earn 3 Relics on the Ashes of the Damned map.

guide.context: The host must have finished the main quest. Relics only appear in Cursed mode, not Standard or Survival.

steps.text: Beat the main quest of Ashes of the Damned yourself, or join a host who already has.
Select the Cursed mode option and play until you unlock 3 Relics.

achievements.description: Complete all 6 Calling Card Challenges in any Zombies Category
achievements.summary: Finish all 6 Calling Card challenges within one Black Ops 7 Zombies category.

guide.context: Each subcategory has exactly 6 challenges. Career, then Fresh Meat is the easiest.

steps.text: Open Zombies, then Career, then Challenges, then Calling Cards, and pick a category.
Finish all 6 challenges in it, such as kill counts with wallbuy or Mystery Box weapons.

achievements.description: Drink 4 different well prepared drinks
achievements.summary: Make 4 different free perk drinks at the diner in Ashes of the Damned, one per match.

guide.context: You can make only one drink per match. Carry only the 3 ingredients for one drink; a wrong or extra ingredient spoils it.

steps.text: In each match, collect the 3 ingredients for one drink and take them to @loc{Reba's Diner} and place them in the cup on the soda machine behind the counter.
Repeat in 4 separate matches, making a different drink each time.
Juggernog: the weed near @loc{Janus Tower Plaza}, the milk can in the @loc{Vandorn Farm} barn, the egg carton in the diner kitchen.
Speed Cola: the flower at @loc{Blackwater Lake House}, the tomato crate at @loc{Hargrove Trading Co.}, the sugar on the diner counter.
Stamin-Up: the potato crate in the @loc{Vandorn Farm} basement, the bag of beans at @loc{Hargrove Trading Co.}, the gas canister at the @loc{Auto Shop}.
Quick Revive: the cleaning solution in the @loc{Janus Tower} server room, the fish on the @loc{Blackwater Lake House} dock, the stimulant in the @loc{Zarya Cosmodrome} control room.

achievements.description: Consume 15 GobbleGums in a single match
achievements.summary: Consume 15 GobbleGums in a single Zombies match.

guide.context: Consumed gums are gone for good, so survive until the 15th.

steps.text: Earn at least 15 GobbleGums by playing Zombies, then equip several copies of up to 5 kinds in your GobbleGum Pack.
In one match, use GobbleGum machines and consume 15 gums.
Pick simple gums such as Shields Up. Anywhere But Here teleports you away.

achievements.description: Kill an Elite Zombie with the final hit coming from a Wisp
achievements.summary: Land the last hit on an Elite Zombie with a Wisp.

steps.text: Switch on the power and open the garage, then drive to the south-east of the map and buy @item{Wisp Tea} near @loc{Zarya Cosmodrome}.
Reach round 16 or later, when @enemy{Elite} bear zombies appear.
Weaken an Elite, then keep shooting nearby zombies until a Wisp spawns and finishes it.
Researching Extension and Mask of Wrath, two augments for Wisp Tea, makes Wisps last longer and hit harder. An Elite stays alive after the round ends, so you can wait for a Wisp in the next round.

achievements.description: Fully upgrade Ol' Tessie
achievements.summary: Fully upgrade Ol' Tessie in Ashes of the Damned.

guide.context: The upgrade is a required step of the main quest. It also counts in Directed Mode, which is easier.

steps.text: Follow the main quest objectives. The upgrade finishes once you fit the Abomination Carcass and the DG-2 Turret Barrel to the car.

achievements.description: Discover the secrets of a war hero
achievements.summary: Find Dempsey's dog tags in Ashes of the Damned and finish the flashback.

guide.context: Only Dempsey can trigger it. The tag is hard to see and fast zombies chase you here, so have a Pack-a-Punched weapon ready.

steps.text: Pick @npc{Dempsey} as your operator before the match.
Turn on the second power switch to open the garage, then go to @loc{Crashed Rocket}, the snowy area between @loc{Ashwood} and @loc{Zarya Cosmodrome}.
Halfway through, behind the crashed capsule, find the small silver dog tag to the right of the corpses and hold the interact button to pick it up.
In the jungle, follow the black orb 3 times and survive the zombie wave each time it stops.
After the third wave you become a monster. Pick up and hurl enemies until the sequence ends.

achievements.description: Get 50 Critical Kills on Zombies slowed by Toxic Growth
achievements.summary: Land 50 critical kills on zombies that Toxic Growth has slowed.

steps.text: Equip @item{Toxic Growth} as your Field Upgrade (unlocked at Player Level 29).
Place thorns where zombies walk, and shoot slowed zombies in the head for critical kills until you reach 50.

achievements.description: Kill 50 Zombies with the Life Drain from a Disciple Injection
achievements.summary: Kill 50 zombies with Life Drain from a Disciple Injection.

guide.context: Crafting Tables are in several places in Zombies, for example the barn that holds the first power switch.

steps.text: Reach Player Level 53 to unlock @item{Disciple Injection}, then craft it at a crafting table for 2500 salvage.
Use the injection to turn into an Elite Zombie, then use Life Drain on zombies until 50 die from it.

achievements.description: Equip 2 Minor Augments each on a Field Upgrade, Perk, and Ammo Mod
achievements.summary: Equip a pair of Minor Augments on each of three items: a Field Upgrade, a Perk and an Ammo Mod.

guide.context: Research progress comes from XP earned in Zombies matches. Reaching round 30 takes about an hour and gives roughly 1.5 of 9 augments. Double XP events speed it up.

steps.text: Open Zombies > Augments > Research Augments and pick a Field Upgrade, a Perk, and an Ammo Mod to research.
Play matches until each of the three reaches 100% augment research.
Fit 2 Minor Augments to every one of the three.

achievements.description: Kill 100 Zombies with explosions from Fire Works
achievements.summary: Kill 100 zombies with explosions from the Fire Works ammo mod.

steps.text: Build @item{Fire Works} at an arsenal station for 500 salvage and equip it.
Shoot zombies until Fire Works triggers and its fireworks kill 100 of them.

achievements.description: Defeat the Papaback and save your dear friend in Dead Ops Arcade
achievements.summary: Defeat the Papaback boss in Dead Ops Arcade.

guide.context: Save and exit removes all enemies on screen.

steps.text: Play Dead Ops Arcade to round 40, where the Papaback appears. Casual difficulty makes it easier.
Defeat the Papaback. You can save and exit between rounds.
Save and exit as soon as the Papaback appears in round 40. This has unlocked the achievement without a kill; if it does not, load the save and redo round 40.

achievements.description: Find your destiny in the Room of Fate in Dead Ops Arcade
achievements.summary: In Dead Ops Arcade, touch a Fate Stone when round 16 ends.

guide.context: It unlocks on its own and cannot be missed.

steps.text: Reach the end of round 16 and touch any Fate Stone.

achievements.description: Get a Chain of 5 chickens strung together in Dead Ops Arcade
achievements.summary: Have 5 chickens chained together in Dead Ops Arcade.

steps.text: At a Slayer Mart, buy 3 @item{5 Minute Chicken} ($750 each) and 1 @item{Bucket of Chicken} ($2000 for 3 chickens).
Start the next round with the chickens. The achievement unlocks then.
Slayer Marts appear in bonus stages and at the end of round 32. Press the reroll button or use a reroll token until the chicken items show up, usually in the top two rows.

achievements.description: Complete the Black Ops 7 Co-Op Campaign
achievements.summary: Complete all 11 missions of the Co-Op Campaign of Black Ops 7.

guide.context: You do not need other players. The Endgame mode is not required.

steps.text: Finish all 11 missions. Turn off Squad Fill before a mission to play solo.
Solo play is easy. Use armor plates and refill them for free at ammo boxes.

achievements.description: Upgrade an Operator to max Combat Rating Co-Op Campaign
achievements.summary: Reach Combat Rating 60 with one Operator in the Co-Op Campaign of Black Ops 7 Endgame.

steps.text: Finish the 11 missions to unlock Endgame, then reach Combat Rating 60 with one Operator.
Spend levels 1-10 in Zone 1, 10-29 in Zone 2, 30-44 in Zone 3, and 45-60 in Zone 4.
Do blue assignments for the most points. Kill @enemy{HVT} targets and shoot down drones for quick progress.
Leave the match on the VTOL to keep your rating.
Dying, disconnecting or leaving without exfiltrating resets your rating to Level 1.
Take skills that add armor plates and health. Keep a Self-Revive. Active Camo and Kinetic Jump make travel and revives safer.

achievements.description: Collect all Intel in Co-Op Campaign
achievements.summary: Collect all 31 Intel items in the Co-Op Campaign of Black Ops 7: 11 in the missions and 20 in Endgame.

guide.context: The 11 mission items are not enough; you also need the 20 Endgame ones. Each item saves when picked up. Mission items can be replayed from mission select, and Endgame items can be taken at Combat Rating 0.

achievements.description: Get 250 Kills with Exotic Weapons in Co-Op Campaign
achievements.summary: Kill 250 enemies with Exotic weapons in the Co-Op Campaign of Black Ops 7.

guide.context: Legendary weapons, the orange upgrade of a normal gun, do not count.

steps.text: Unlock Endgame, then find gold-rarity @item{Exotic} weapons in Zone 4, especially as rewards from green activities in the south near the Fort.
Get 250 kills with them.
The main boss in the south of Zone 4 (red skull icon) usually drops an Exotic weapon.

achievements.description: Complete Exposure in Co-Op Campaign
achievements.summary: Complete the mission Exposure in the Co-Op Campaign of Black Ops 7.

guide.context: It unlocks on its own.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Exposure}, the first mission.

achievements.description: Complete Inside and Distortion in Co-Op Campaign
achievements.summary: Complete the missions Inside and Distortion in the Co-Op Campaign of Black Ops 7.

guide.context: It unlocks on its own.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Inside} and @loc{Distortion}, missions 2 and 3.

achievements.displayName: We Didn't Need a Bigger Boat
achievements.description: Complete Escalation and Disruption in Co-Op Campaign
achievements.summary: Complete the missions Escalation and Disruption in the Co-Op Campaign of Black Ops 7.

guide.context: It unlocks on its own.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Escalation} and @loc{Disruption}, missions 4 and 5.

achievements.description: Complete Collapse and Fracture in Co-Op Campaign
achievements.summary: Complete the missions Collapse and Fracture in the Co-Op Campaign of Black Ops 7.

guide.context: It unlocks on its own.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Collapse} and @loc{Fracture}, missions 6 and 7.

achievements.description: Complete Quarantine and Suppression in Co-Op Campaign
achievements.summary: Complete the missions Quarantine and Suppression in the Co-Op Campaign of Black Ops 7.

guide.context: It unlocks on its own.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Quarantine} and @loc{Suppression}, missions 8 and 9.

achievements.description: Complete Breakpoint and Containment in Co-Op Campaign
achievements.summary: Complete the missions Breakpoint and Containment in the Co-Op Campaign of Black Ops 7.

guide.context: It unlocks on its own.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Breakpoint} and @loc{Containment}, missions 10 and 11.

achievements.description: Revive a teammate in Co-Op Campaign
achievements.summary: Revive a teammate in the Co-Op Campaign of Black Ops 7.

guide.context: Only the player who revives gets it.

steps.text: Play a co-op mission with a partner, using Squad Fill or a friend.
When your partner goes down, hold the interact button next to them to revive them.

achievements.description: Glide 800m continuously with the wingsuit in Co-Op Campaign
achievements.summary: Glide 800 meters in one go with the wingsuit in the Co-Op Campaign of Black Ops 7.

steps.text: Unlock Endgame. At the start you jump out of a plane.
Open the wingsuit and tilt the stick slightly up to stay in the air for 800 m.

achievements.description: Successfully Sneak Across the Yacht's Deck in Disruption
achievements.summary: Reach the lower yacht deck in Disruption without entering open combat.

guide.context: You may shoot guards. The stealth ability lasts a few seconds. Learn the path first, then restart.

steps.text: Start @loc{Disruption} on the yacht. Headshot the first guard on your deck, then the guard on the left path.
Take the far-left path on the glass balcony and headshot the guard there.
Leaving the balcony, headshot the two close guards on the left quickly. One may notice the other kill; kill him before he shoots.
Enter the room they guarded, open the floor hatch and go down.
Take the left path, headshot guards from behind, and follow it to the end until the cutscene starts.
Spotted? Quit the match and start the mission again.

achievements.description: Complete 10 Assignments in Zone IV in Co-Op Campaign
achievements.summary: Complete 10 Assignments in Zone IV of the Co-Op Campaign of Black Ops 7 Endgame.

steps.text: Unlock Endgame and level up in the lower zones. Aim for Combat Rating 45 before Zone 4.
In Zone 4, complete blue assignments. Green activities do not count.
Assignments to kill HVT targets are usually the fastest. Progress counts across all matches, and you can repeat the same assignment.

achievements.description: Obtain the defector's location in 'Following Orders' without hurting any civilians.
achievements.summary: Get the defector's location in Following Orders without hurting any civilian.

guide.context: It unlocks when you get the location unharmed. Replay the mission if a civilian is hurt.

steps.text: Collect the first house contraband and talk to the woman. Pick the dialogue lines that make her go stand with her husband in the hallway.
Ask the man about the contraband items, one by one.
Never strike or shoot either civilian.

achievements.description: Complete the game on any Difficulty.
achievements.summary: Complete the Modern Warfare 4 campaign on any difficulty.

guide.context: Finishing also unlocks Realism difficulty.

steps.text: Play the 16 missions in order and finish @loc{Greater Good}.

achievements.description: Complete the game on Realism difficulty.
achievements.summary: Complete the Modern Warfare 4 campaign on Realism difficulty.

guide.context: Realism hides the HUD and uses Veteran enemies.

steps.text: After finishing the campaign once, start a new run on Realism.
Play the missions in order. After Greater Good on Realism, do not go back to earlier missions.
Keep your plates up, use ammo boxes, mount your weapon on cover, and keep your distance.

achievements.description: Kill 10 paratroopers in 'Mayhem' before they hit the ground.
achievements.summary: Kill 10 paratroopers in Mayhem before they land.

guide.context: It unlocks at the tenth air kill; you do not need to finish the mission.

steps.text: In @loc{Mayhem}, move with your squad onto the stadium field.
Shoot each wave while it is still in the air. Ignore landed ones.
Lowering FOV to 60 makes them easier to hit. If it does not unlock, restart the checkpoint.

achievements.description: Defeat all enemies in the kitchen of 'Out in the Cold' without firing your gun on Hardened or harder
achievements.summary: Defeat every enemy in the Out in the Cold kitchen with no shots fired, on Hardened or harder.

guide.context: 5 enemies must be beaten without a shot.

steps.text: Set difficulty to Hardened or Veteran before the mission.
Grab bottles off the bar tables before you reach the kitchen.
Go through the kitchen door, hit the enemy on your right with a bottle and use a takedown. Do the same to the 2 other close enemies.
Rush the final two enemies behind the counter and punch them.
Switch to melee first. Takedowns with a weapon out do not count. A single shot means you must restart the checkpoint.

achievements.description: Defeat Makarov on Veteran difficulty or higher without getting hit in the alley.
achievements.summary: Defeat Makarov without taking any hit in the alley, on Veteran difficulty or higher.

steps.text: Switch to Veteran before the Makarov fight.
In part 1, hold guard and attack while holding it.
In part 2, attack in between guards, since holding guard too long stuns you. Do not attack fast while his guard is up.
A red HUD indicator means you were hit. Restart the checkpoint.

achievements.description: Confiscate all of the contraband and read all of the notes in 'Following Orders'.
achievements.summary: Confiscate all contraband and read all notes in Following Orders.

guide.context: Do not hurt the civilians, or Note From Mom cannot be collected. You can replay the mission from mission select.

achievements.summary: Get 50 kills in Hired Gun while you stand on train cars.

Finishing under 50 means reloading a checkpoint or replaying the mission.
Recruit difficulty makes this more predictable. Ground kills do not count; moving and stopped cars both work.

achievements.description: Kill 15 enemies with 3 mortar rounds in a row in 'Losing Ground'.
achievements.summary: Kill 15 enemies with 3 mortar shots in a row in Losing Ground.

guide.context: You can keep firing; any 3 shots in a row count.

steps.text: At the mortar in @loc{Losing Ground}, wait for the big wave from the right.
Fire at groups, about 5 kills per shot, until 3 shots in a row reach 15.
Do not waste shots on empty ground. If you miss, reload the checkpoint or restart the mission.

achievements.summary: Kill every enemy after Shin dies in Assassins, on Hardened or harder.

guide.context: It conflicts with Pacifist, so earn them in separate attempts. It unlocks at the last kill. Replay the mission if you miss.

steps.text: Set difficulty to Hardened or higher before the mission.
After Shin dies, clear each area before moving on. The library and kitchen hold 13 enemies; kill them before the garden.
Enemies wait at the top of the stairs on your left when you enter the garden. More spawn behind you when you open the bunker door.
Use knives and throwing knives for stealth; you have no armor.

achievements.description: Complete 'Assassins' by only killing one enemy.
achievements.summary: Complete Assassins while killing only one enemy.

guide.context: It conflicts with Revenge, so earn them in separate attempts. Replay the mission if you fail.

steps.text: Sneak through @loc{Assassins}, throwing bottles in the kitchen to distract guards, or hide in the kitchen storages.
Let the cutscene kill count as your one kill.

achievements.description: Repair everything in Base Camp.
achievements.summary: Repair everything in Base Camp in Stranded.

guide.context: If everything seems done but nothing unlocks, the missed craft is usually the Semtex or the Vulcan suppressor. You can return to Base Camp after finishing the campaign.

steps.text: Gather materials by opening yellow crates and clearing outposts, then repair every item at @loc{Base Camp}.
Check @item{Semtex}. Throw away all your lethals, then check Base Camp again. A lethal you already carry hides the craft.
Pick up the Vulcan sniper rifle lying before the @loc{SAM Site} statue. That adds a suppressor craft to the table beneath the ammo bag.

achievements.description: Destroy every vehicle reinforcement at the SAM Site before they unload in 'Stranded'.
achievements.summary: At the Stranded SAM Site, blow up all reinforcement vehicles before their soldiers get out.

guide.context: It unlocks when all vehicles and the BMP are destroyed.

steps.text: Finish the jamming station objective first to unlock explosive drones.
Stock about 10 drones. More are in the boxes around the statue.
At the @loc{SAM Site}, look north and fly drones at the vehicles on the main road as they approach. Do not wait.
The drone's out-of-range alert can be ignored. Do not use the craftable anti-material sniper; soldiers leave the vehicle as soon as it is hit.
Do not restart from a checkpoint during this. Doing so made the achievement fail. If it does fail, replay the mission.

achievements.description: Snipe all 4 enemies firing the mortars in 'Counter Attack'.
achievements.summary: Snipe all 4 enemies firing mortars in Counter Attack.

steps.text: Reach the hotel roof in @loc{Counter Attack} with a sniper rifle.
Kill both soldiers at the mortar by the city hall on the left, then both at the mortar on the garage roof farther left.
Killing one soldier makes the other run. If one escapes, reload the checkpoint.

achievements.description: Recover the Dog Tags in 'Escape'.
achievements.summary: Recover Gaz's dog tags from the wall safe in Escape.

steps.text: At the start of @loc{Escape}, read the Confiscation Protocol Reminder note; it sits on a desk in the office after the first guard, first door on your left.
Pass the guard checkpoint and enter the security office. Hide until the soldier gets a phone call and leaves. Then read the note showing the new code, 8410.
Rescue Ghost and clear the barracks. Then find the room with the wall safe, enter the code and take the dog tags.

achievements.description: In Entrenched, kill 15 enemies with a shotgun before securing the Target Building.
achievements.summary: Before securing the Target Building in Entrenched, get 15 shotgun kills.

steps.text: Start @loc{Entrenched} with a shotgun equipped.
Push through both sets of trenches using only the shotgun, and wait to secure the Target Building until 15 kills are done.
A soldier with a long-barrelled shotgun appears about halfway; take it.
